mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mis_residual_inventory WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND locked_qty > 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM mis_residual_inventory WHERE stock_out_detail_id = #{stockOutDetailId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mis_residual_inventory SET locked_qty = locked_qty + #{lockQty}, status = CASE WHEN (qty - locked_qty - #{lockQty}) <= 0 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE status END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (qty - locked_qty) >= #{lockQty} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE mis_residual_inventory SET locked_qty = locked_qty - #{unlockQty}, status = CASE WHEN (locked_qty - #{unlockQty}) <= 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE status END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_qty >= #{unlockQty} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE mis_residual_inventory SET qty = qty - #{deductQty}, locked_qty = locked_qty - #{deductQty}, status = CASE WHEN (qty - #{deductQty}) <= 0 THEN 'USED' WHEN (locked_qty - #{deductQty}) <= 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'LOCKED' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND qty >= #{deductQty} AND locked_qty >= #{deductQty} AND del_flag = '0'
